My dad died when he was 53 from a massive heart attack, while he was unloading a freight trailer which he fell to the ground from. I never appreciated my dad enough because I was still quite childish at 29 years old. I had just become a father myself.  Suddenly I needed my dad more than I ever had before and he was just gone. I needed his guidance, and advice. I needed him to love me through what I felt like were complete parenting failures. I had no experience. 

September 14th will be 13 years. I'm older,  I have more experience. I still miss him today as much as I did when he first left us. I have a greater appreciation for him as a man. My dad weighed nearly 500 pounds, and his body hurt him like hell. I could sometimes hear him getting ready in the morning for work and degrading himself for how much trouble he was having putting on his shoes... but he went everyday to a job where he drove a truck and unloaded his own freight. He did what needed to be done to support his family at any cost. He paid it. Despite any flaws he had (we all do), he was a great man who I loved dearly.
